final-manifest.json.scope: Post-hoc finite-envelope arithmetic diagnostic only; no audio/source/default/test/threshold change. Unknown onset offset can change rate value even with exact .6s separation. Original plan/results plus clarification and independent review retained.

curvature_limits: The .6s time separation is invariant to a constant onset-clock offset. Finite RATE VALUES need not be invariant when log-power curves; source/model intervals can sample different physical envelope ages.
Midpoint departures are reported without censoring and can be many dB, so a single finite rate is not a fitted exponential, intrinsic modalT60, or material loss identification.
Polarization/beating/time-varying transduction/undetectedgesture remain possible; no outcome-driven model/source mask or fitted constant is justified.
independent-review/review.json.status: PASS all184note rows×5metrics, source-only whole-span qualification, identicalIDs and all aggregate distributions

onset-offset-clarification.json.changes: Clarification only. Preserve original protocol/results bytes and every window, guard, value, formula, admission, profile and audio. README narrowed before publication.
onset-offset-clarification.json.correction: The plan's statement that later window spacing cancels a fixed onset offset concerns only the time separation of .6s. A constant unknown onset offset need not cancel from the finite rate value: source and model can cover different physical envelope ages, especially for curved or non-monotonic log-power. No acoustic-age equivalence or intrinsic modal decay identification follows.

calculation.aggregation: Exact per-note values, all-notes and per-string distributions, and separate every-fret rows/values. All four contexts and all failures retained.
calculation.finite_rate: (value_at_1.1s - value_at_.5s)/.6s in dB/s, source and model separately and model-minus-source. Whole-crop gain cancels within each track.
calculation.midpoint_departure: value_at_.8s - (value_at_.5s + value_at_1.1s)/2 in dB; always report, never censor by curvature.
calculation.values: Use original frozen per-window values. Ratios already use dB. No regression fitting, extrapolation, T60 inference, partial waveform fitting or nuisance subtraction.

limits: Finite-window partial envelopes can include polarization/interference, time-varying excitation and handling; these are not intrinsic modal decay rates.
Existing source rise detector can miss activity, and the MIDI onset has uncertain relation to acoustic onset. Later window spacing cancels a fixed onset offset but not intervening unknown gestures.
No source/physical force, age or picking position calibration; no new physics constant, loss curve, EQ, default, source code or authenticity percentage follows.
prospective-derivation.json.motivation: Already observed known-Neck late-body aggregate deficits motivate distinguishing fixed spectral offset from differential cooling. This is a post-hoc mechanism diagnostic, not the original late-body endpoint or a new candidate qualification.
qualification: Require the existing source-only metric admission at ALL THREE .5/.8/1.1s windows. Retain every unqualified note, row and reason.

Additionally reject a slope if any frozen 6dB activity candidate occurs inside the enclosing first-window-start to last-window-end plus 25ms, or any existing source attenuation interval intersects that interval. This covers gaps between windows; do not alter old masks.
No model guards or outcome-based inclusion. All model contexts use identical source-qualified note IDs for each metric.
